name: SewPro
industry: FashionTech / SaaS for Tailors & Fashion Businesses
what_they_do: Abuja-based fashion-tech startup (Sewprofessional Nigeria Ltd, founded by Andrew Ogbeh) offering the SewPro mobile app for tailors and fashion entrepreneurs to store client measurements, co-create designs, automate pickup/payment reminders, and manage invoicing.
recent_activity: 2026-11-10: Won NGN 5M (~$3,711) non-dilutive grant among Top 8 of the FMYD/NiYA-Cascador Founders Programme (https://techcabal.com/2026/11/10/cascador-niya-select-eight-founders/); 2026-11-24: Published product explainer carousel on @sewpro_ Instagram (https://instagram.com/p/DgIJe0QkTYT); 2026-11-17: Featured in NiYA-Cascador Top 20 recap reel (https://instagram.com/p/Df1k9cvhosI)
investors: Cascador / Nigerian Youth Academy (NiYA) / Federal Ministry of Youth Development
marketing_titles_found: NONE (sewpro.app/about-us names only Founder Andrew Ogbeh; no public team directory or marketing/growth/content titles)
hiring_marketing_role: NO (no careers or open roles page on sewpro.app)
unique_offer: All-in-one tailoring management mobile app for African fashion entrepreneurs covering client measurements, design approvals, deadline alerts, and in-app payments.
pitch_hook: SewPro claims 10k+ fashion business users and won NGN 5M in NiYA-Cascador funding on 2026-11-10, yet sewpro.app has no blog or SEO content engine, no public marketing or growth lead beyond founder Andrew Ogbeh, and no web-linked Instagram profile in its site footer.
